purpose.zh: 用毛巾练背阔肌和肩胛下沉
purpose.en: Train your lats and shoulder blade control with a towel.

text.zh: 向外拉紧毛巾，手肘向下向后拉
text.en: Pull the towel apart and drive your elbows down and back

text.zh: 双手宽握毛巾，从头顶V字开始
text.en: Hold the towel wide, starting with your arms in a V overhead.

text.zh: 肩胛下沉夹紧，再推回头顶不松毛巾
text.en: Squeeze your shoulder blades down, then press back up without letting the towel go slack.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your shoulders hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
